content: पार्श्व {%a.%} Near, proximate. .{@-र्श्वः, -र्श्वम्@} [पर्शूनां समूहः] .²1 The part of the body below the arm-pit, the region of the ribs; वामं पार्श्वं विनिर्भिद्य सुतः सूर्य इव स्थितः <ls>Mb. 3. 126. 27</ls>; शयने सन्निषण्णैकपार्श्वाम् <ls>Me. 91</ls>. .²2 The side, flank (in general) (of animate or inanimate objects), पिठरं क्वथदतिमात्रं निजपार्श्वानेव दहतितराम् <ls>Pt. 1. 324</ls>. .²3 Vicinity. .²4 <ab>Ved.</ab> A curved knife. .{@-र्श्वः@} An epithet of the twenty-third Tīrthaṅkar of the Jainas. .{@-र्श्वम्@} .²1 A multitude of ribs. .²2 A fraudulent expedient, a dishonourable means. .²3 The extremity of the fore-axle of a wheel. (पार्श्वम् is used adverbially in the sense of ‘near to’, ‘by the side of’, ‘towards’; केनाप्युत्क्षिपतेव पश्य भुवनं मत्पार्श्वमानीयते <ls>Ś. 7. 8</ls>; so पार्श्वात् ‘from the side of, away, from’; पार्श्वे ‘near’, ‘at hand’, ‘at the side’; नमे दूरे किंचित् क्षणमपि न पार्श्वे रथजवात् <ls>Ś. 1. 9</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 37.</ls>)
